description: Any object that replaces a real collaborator in a test, such as a dummy, stub, fake, spy or mock.
A double that returns canned answers so the code under test gets the inputs the test needs.
A simple but working implementation of a collaborator, such as an in-memory store backed by a map.
A double whose interactions are verified after the code runs, for example that a notifier was called once.
A Mockito object that records the argument passed to a mock so the test can assert on its contents.
The MockitoExtension default that fails a test for unused stubs and for stubbed calls made with different arguments.
The instrumentation Mockito needs, which on JDK 21 and later is best attached explicitly as a Java agent.
